title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda highlighting India's steps towards easing the burden of cancer treatment and ensuring affordable healthcare
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Union Minister, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda. The article highlights how, from reducing the cost of anti-cancer medicines to strengthening cancer care infrastructure, India is taking important steps towards easing the burden on patients and their families. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Access to quality healthcare must never be limited by affordability. Here’s an insight and a way forward by Union Minister Shri @JPNadda, from reducing the cost of anti-cancer medicines to strengthening cancer care infrastructure, India is taking important steps towards easing the burden on patients and their families.
